Trial 7 ended in death. The screen reads "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the chat line "angelasq was shot by Stray".

What I saw:
- At the start a single armored humanoid mob stood on a hill directly ahead. I moved and jumped up the slope toward it, but it left my view as I climbed.
- Health fell steadily from full to zero across about eight actions while I could not see the attacker. The death message confirms it was a Stray shooting arrows from range, with the slowness effect likely explaining the rapid loss.
- Only on the last two frames did a translucent, bluish silhouette appear to the right of center, after I had raised the shield and turned. My one attack toward it came as the trial ended.

Input problems: none observed. Camera and key inputs applied as sent. The failure was mine: I lost track of the mob's position after the first screenshot and should have raised the shield and scanned earlier rather than charging blind.
